# scamp_vps_images (Data Source)

Retrieves the systems a Simple VPS can be installed with.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Image id, the value for scamp_vps.image.
- `os` (String) Operating system.
- `version` (String) Version of the system.
